Marked on the underside “Carter Sterling  Cement Filled  Reinforced  2593.” These are genuine sterling silver pieces with cement-filled weighted bases, a traditional construction used to provide stability.

The set displays an attractive aged patina with visible tarnish, surface wear, and signs of use consistent with age. They have not been polished, allowing the buyer to retain the original patina or polish them to their preference.
Includes all three candlestick holders shown.

description:
Sheaffer
Desk Fountain Pen with Tapered Body
Vintage, Silver-Tone Nib Made in USA
This vintage Sheaffer desk fountain pen features a classic mid-century design with a sleek, tapered black resin body and a professional silver-tone nib. As a piece of American stationery history, Sheaffer's desk sets were staples of the executive office, known for their reliability and streamlined aesthetic that complemented the modernist decor of the mid-20th century.
Sleek tapered black resin body with silver-tone trim and nib
Nib stamped with readable "SHEAFFER" and "USA" identification marks
Includes heavy rounded desk base for vertical display and storage
Overall dimensions: 4" Length x 6" Width x 7" Height
Condition:
Fair to good vintage condition. The nib shows significant dried ink residue and purple staining, requiring cleaning. The barrel exhibits surface wear, light scratching, and some discoloration near the grip section. The desk base appears stable and intact with minor surface dust and typical age-related wear to the finish.

shipping.policy:
We use FedEx as our contracted shipping carrier and follow their packaging guidelines. Keep in mind, FedEx now uses a volumetric calculation to determine shipping estimates. This is called
dimensional weight
and refers to the amount of space a package occupies in relation to its actual weight. For more information regarding dimensional weight, please visit:
https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/packaging/what-is-dimensional-weight.html
.
Once payment has cleared, orders are generally processed within 5 business days, not including weekends or holidays.
Goodwill Industries of the Inland Northwest will not be held liable for lost or stolen packages if they are marked
delivered
within the tracking details. It is the responsibility of the customer to contact the shipping carrier to inquire about the claims process for reimbursement. We are happy to provide the necessary paperwork to facilitate this process.
Purchased items will be shipped as specified within the order. We are unable to reroute packages once processed. Please ensure any address changes are made prior to payment during the checkout process. Per FedEx policies, we cannot accept P.O. boxes, please provide us with a physical address.
Buyers may also arrange their own third-party shipping service for pick-up only items. However, the carrier must assume all responsibility for the item and must be able to retrieve, pack, and ship. Please submit a customer service ticket for inquiry.
Combined shipping
Due to automation, items can only be combined prior to payment being received. Eligible items must meet the following criteria:
The items are from the same Goodwill location.
The items close within the same week.
You have not already paid for any of the items.
The combined weight does not exceed 20 pounds.
Items are not already in a fixed-price, flat-rate shipping box.
Items can't be purchased via buy-it-now or with 1 cent shipping.
You will be automatically prompted to combine all available items during checkout. If the site does not, please submit a customer service ticket for inquiry; some exceptions may be made.

insurance

Additional charges are assessed for special shipping requests, such as packing method, expediting, and more, starting at a minimum of $20.

Buyers are responsible for timely payment of all shipping-related charges.

Description:
Discover natural history with this striking Orthoceras fossil stone featuring a unique starburst pattern. Crafted by the earth over millions of years, this remarkable specimen showcases a radiating, creamy fossil embedded in a deep black limestone matrix. Its dramatic contrast makes it a prime display piece for collectors and enthusiasts alike. This Orthoceras fossil fragment is believed to originate from Morocco, a renowned source of these ancient marine fossils. The starburst orthoceras imprint stands out beautifully against the dark stone, offering both scientific intrigue and visual appeal. Perfect for display on shelves, desks, or curio cabinets, it makes a fascinating conversation starter and educational gift for those interested in geology or prehistoric life. Rest assured, this stone is naturally formed and selected for its standout fossil structure and aesthetics. Add a distinctive, museum-quality piece to your collection and enjoy lasting beauty that connects you to Earth's distant past.
